list.name: topic
list.label: Topic
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT topic FROM streaming.pipeline_runs ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT topic FROM streaming.pipeline_runs ORDER BY 1

list.name: spark_run_id
list.label: Spark run
list.query:
SELECT spark_run_id::text AS __value, left(spark_run_id::text,8) || ' | ' || topic || ' | ' || to_char(started_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS __text
FROM streaming.pipeline_runs WHERE topic IN ($topic) ORDER BY started_at DESC
list.definition:
SELECT spark_run_id::text AS __value, left(spark_run_id::text,8) || ' | ' || topic || ' | ' || to_char(started_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS __text
FROM streaming.pipeline_runs WHERE topic IN ($topic) ORDER BY started_at DESC

list.name: experiment_run_id
list.label: Experiment run
list.query:
SELECT run_id::text AS __value, experiment_type || ' | ' || topic || ' | ' || to_char(started_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS __text
FROM streaming.experiment_runs ORDER BY started_at DESC
list.definition:
SELECT run_id::text AS __value, experiment_type || ' | ' || topic || ' | ' || to_char(started_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS __text
FROM streaming.experiment_runs ORDER BY started_at DESC

panels.title: Input / processed throughput
panels.description: Nguồn: pipeline_batch_metrics. Đơn vị rows/second. NULL giữ nguyên, không thay bằng 0.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT observed_at AS time, input_rows_per_second AS "Input rows/s", processed_rows_per_second AS "Processed rows/s"
FROM streaming.pipeline_batch_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter(observed_at) AND spark_run_id::text IN ($spark_run_id) AND topic IN ($topic)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Consumer lag (tổng và lớn nhất)
panels.description: consumer_lag = latest_offset - end_offset. Đơn vị records.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT observed_at AS time, total_consumer_lag AS "Total lag", max_partition_lag AS "Max partition lag"
FROM streaming.pipeline_batch_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter(observed_at) AND spark_run_id::text IN ($spark_run_id) AND topic IN ($topic)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: End-to-end latency (p95 / avg / max)
panels.description: end_to_end_latency_ms = thời điểm Spark xử lý - produced_at. p95 do Spark job tính theo từng micro-batch.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT observed_at AS time, latency_p95_ms AS "p95", latency_avg_ms AS "avg", latency_max_ms AS "max"
FROM streaming.pipeline_batch_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter(observed_at) AND spark_run_id::text IN ($spark_run_id) AND topic IN ($topic)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Watermark: độ trễ so với thời điểm quan sát
panels.description: Khoảng cách giữa observed_at và watermark_at (giây). Batch chưa có watermark (mốc 1970) được coi là NULL, và giữa observed_at và max_event_time.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT observed_at AS time,
  CASE WHEN watermark_at > '2000-01-01' THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (observed_at - watermark_at)) END AS "Watermark gap (s)",
  CASE WHEN max_event_time > '2000-01-01' THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (observed_at - max_event_time)) END AS "Max event time gap (s)"
FROM streaming.pipeline_batch_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter(observed_at) AND spark_run_id::text IN ($spark_run_id) AND topic IN ($topic)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Số dòng bị loại bởi watermark

targets.rawSql:
SELECT observed_at AS time, rows_dropped_by_watermark AS "Dropped rows"
FROM streaming.pipeline_batch_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter(observed_at) AND spark_run_id::text IN ($spark_run_id) AND topic IN ($topic)
ORDER BY 1

SELECT observed_at AS time, checkpoint_commit_ms AS "Checkpoint commit", wal_commit_ms AS "WAL commit", commit_offsets_ms AS "Commit offsets"
FROM streaming.pipeline_batch_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter(observed_at) AND spark_run_id::text IN ($spark_run_id) AND topic IN ($topic)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Số transaction theo window và merchant_category
panels.description: Nguồn: transaction_window_results, mốc thời gian là window_start.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT window_start AS time, merchant_category AS metric, transaction_count AS value
FROM streaming.transaction_window_results
WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND topic IN ($topic)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Tổng giá trị transaction theo window (VND)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT window_start AS time, merchant_category AS metric, total_amount_vnd AS value
FROM streaming.transaction_window_results
WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND topic IN ($topic)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Thống kê theo merchant_category
panels.description: Tổng hợp trong khoảng thời gian đang chọn.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT merchant_category,
  SUM(transaction_count) AS transactions,
  SUM(total_amount_vnd) AS total_amount_vnd,
  ROUND(SUM(total_amount_vnd)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(transaction_count),0), 2) AS avg_amount_vnd,
  MIN(min_amount_vnd) AS min_amount_vnd,
  MAX(max_amount_vnd) AS max_amount_vnd,
  SUM(simulated_late_count) AS late_events,
  ROUND(SUM(average_event_lateness_ms * transaction_count) / NULLIF(SUM(transaction_count),0), 2) AS avg_lateness_ms
FROM streaming.transaction_window_results
WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND topic IN ($topic)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: So sánh rate, late ratio và partition giữa các thí nghiệm
panels.description: Nguồn: experiment_scenarios JOIN experiment_runs. Lọc theo biến experiment_run_id.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT r.experiment_type, s.scenario_name, s.topic,
  s.partition_count, s.active_partitions, s.partition_balance_cv_percent,
  s.target_rate_events_s, s.delivered_rate_events_s, s.rate_achievement_percent,
  s.target_late_ratio_percent, s.actual_late_ratio_percent, s.late_delay_seconds,
  s.delivered, s.failed, s.delivery_success_percent, s.status
FROM streaming.experiment_scenarios s
JOIN streaming.experiment_runs r ON r.run_id = s.run_id
WHERE r.run_id::text = ANY(ARRAY[$experiment_run_id]::text[])
ORDER BY r.started_at, s.sequence_number

panels.title: Các lần chạy Spark
panels.description: pipeline_run_status: effective_status suy ra từ heartbeat. query_id giữ nguyên khi dùng lại checkpoint, spark_run_id đổi mỗi lần khởi động.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT spark_run_id, query_id, topic, partition_count, started_at, finished_at, effective_status, watermark_delay_seconds, window_duration_seconds
FROM streaming.pipeline_run_status
WHERE topic IN ($topic)
ORDER BY started_at DESC
